verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants query Pulumi Cloud stacks and resources, search cloud resources, generate infrastructure code, and optionally delegate tasks to Pulumi Neo. The docs list supported clients (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Claude Desktop), and a probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work through the server in practice.
